label: ETERNAL_1: Eternity has neither beginning nor end and is without succession, all at once; it is not…
term: eternal (ST I q.10; Lean parameter `Eternal` of `GodIsEternal`)
definition: Eternity has neither beginning nor end and is without succession, all at once (ST I q.10 a.1); it is not merely endless time. In stage 2 Eternal is a primitive predicate supplied to GodIsEternal and ClassicalAttributesSuffice.
note: ImmutableIsEternalReading states only that being in potency in no respect suffices for Eternal. It does not encode time, beginning, end or succession, so the intended sourced meaning is not a new definitionally enforced temporal theorem.
